fusions.name: Headlong Scrum
fusions.desc: Your swarm butts into one enemy at once, dealing 13 damage, knocking it 3 tiles back and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: From the Rafters
fusions.desc: You drop from a height onto one enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Dig In Your Claws
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds, with +8% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Won't Be Shifted
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
